results.matched_title: Missing ownership check for accessing user's dashboard

baseline_findings.title: Missing ownership check for story edit and delete operations
baseline_findings.description: The `/edit/:id` and `/delete/:id` routes do not perform an ownership check to ensure that only the owner of a story can edit or delete it. This allows any authenticated user to modify or delete another user's story.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The route handlers for `/edit/:id` and `/delete/:id` do not check if the authenticated user is the owner of the story before allowing them to edit or delete it. The `ensureAuth` middleware ensures that a user is logged in, but it does not verify ownership.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: route handler; required control: ownership (this user may only touch their own records)
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an ownership check to ensure that only the owner of a story can edit or delete it. This can be done by comparing the authenticated user's ID with the story's owner ID before allowing the operation to proceed.

baseline_findings.title: Missing Authorization for Dashboard Route
baseline_findings.description: The `/dashboard` route requires authentication to access, but the function does not enforce any authorization checks beyond ensuring the user is logged in. This could allow an authenticated user to view another user's dashboard if they know the other user's ID.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The `/dashboard` route requires authentication, but it does not enforce any authorization checks beyond ensuring the user is logged in. This could allow an authenticated user to view another user's dashboard if they know the other user's ID.
baseline_findings.data_flow_summary: operation: route handler; required control: authorization (role)
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Ensure that the function enforces ownership by checking if the current user is the owner of the resource before allowing access to the dashboard.

baseline_findings.title: Missing ownership check for deleting a story
baseline_findings.description: The route `/stories/:id` (line 107) allows any authenticated user to delete a story, regardless of whether the story belongs to them. This is because there is no check to ensure that the `req.user.id` matches the `story.user._id`. An attacker could potentially delete another user's story if they know the ID.
baseline_findings.context_reasoning: The route `/stories/:id` does not check if the authenticated user is the owner of the story before allowing deletion. The `ensureAuth` middleware ensures that a user is logged in, but it does not verify ownership.
baseline_findings.suggested_fix: Add an ownership check to ensure that the authenticated user is the owner of the story before deleting it. This can be done by adding a condition to check if `req.user.id === story.user._id` before allowing deletion.
